newsitem.title: TURKEY: Fugitive Turkish police hand themselves in.
newsitem.headline: Fugitive Turkish police hand themselves in.

text.p: Turkey's justice minister said on Monday six suspended police officers, on the run and wanted in connection with the death of a leftist journalist, had handed themselves in.
Anatolian news agency quoted Oltan Sungurlu saying that one commander and five officers had turned themselves in to officials in the western town of Afyon.
A court in the town is hearing the case against 48 policemen charged with involvement in the killing of Metin Goktepe.
Goktepe was beaten to death while in police custody in January 1996. He was one of scores of people rounded up for an identity check after the funerals of two far-left prisoners.
Prime Minister Mesut Yilmaz last week promised the fugitive officers would be brought to court.
